//regions: Supabase lives in AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai). Without this, functions default to iad1 (Washington DC) and every DB round-trip crosses ~12,000 km — roughly 200ms each, paid per query, on a pool capped at 1 connection. bom1 is Vercel's Mumbai region: same-region RTT is single-digit ms. Users are in India too, so this shortens the browser hop as well. If the DB ever moves, move this with it.
